keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

left_out.reason: 'evaluated baselines' is evaluation boilerplate, not a topic.
'success rate' is a metric phrase appearing in any robotics or agent paper.
'forward pass' is a generic computation term, not a research topic.
'synthetic data' is a data-source descriptor spanning vision, language, and robotics.
'self-improvement' is an umbrella for unrelated recursive-training loops with no shared method.
'regret' is a theoretical quantity used across many unrelated learning-theory analyses.
'gradient descent' is a generic optimizer name, not a distinguishing topic.
'intermediate states' is a vague process descriptor.
'pretrained models' is generic; papers here are about many different topics.
'actor' is a generic RL component name.
'continual learning' is a long-standing setting word; this week's papers only use it as a frame.
'highest mean' is a results-table phrase, not a topic.
'foundation models' is field-wide and flat this week.
'privileged' is a property word, not a topic.

top_papers.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
top_papers.authors: Team Kandinsky, Julia Agafonova, Bulat Akhmatov et al.
top_papers.why: Presents a large synchronized audio-video foundation model with strong human evaluation results, useful for multimodal generation researchers.
top_papers.key_result: The paper presents Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters), which generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio and up to Full-HD (1920×1080) resolution. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.
evidence: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).

Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920×1080).

In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.

top_papers.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
top_papers.authors: Shaokun Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Jian Hu et al.
top_papers.why: Introduces a memory-efficient RL post-training method that reduces memory by up to 45.7% and enables 27B-parameter training on a single 8-GPU node, addressing a major practical bottleneck.
top_papers.key_result: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance, and it enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node where dense Adam runs out of memory.
evidence: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical.
Over the complete runs, average memory decreases from 9.18 to 7.18 GiB at 1.5B and from 31.82 to 17.29 GiB at 7B, reductions of 21.8% and 45.7%, respectively.

top_papers.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
top_papers.authors: Zongxia Li, Yucheng Shi, Zhongzhi Li et al.
top_papers.why: It demonstrates a scalable self-distillation pipeline that converts harness-specific successes into general training trajectories, yielding large gains on terminal-task benchmarks.
top_papers.key_result: Training on RSR's rewritten trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT: compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on the self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on the Software Terminal-Bench, while process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29. This followed multi-harness discovery in which three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool.
evidence: Across approximately 3K self-curated terminal tasks, three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool.

RSR expands 2,001 successful source trajectories into 11,094 rewritten trajectories for supervised finetuning. Training on these trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT.

Compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on our self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on our Software Terminal-Bench. top_papers.key_result: ProWAM sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%; it also achieves a 48.1% success rate on RoboCasa365 and 18.2% on the Composite-Unseen split, and reaches 70.0% success in zero-shot real-world experiments, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain).
evidence: On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%.

Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes.

top_papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
top_papers.authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu et al.
top_papers.why: Strong result showing autoregressive pretraining unlocks long-context world-action models, advancing real-time robot control.
top_papers.key_result: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long; Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO, and real-world deployment includes 95% success on dynamic cup stacking.
evidence: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long.
Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO.
Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where _0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials.

top_papers.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
top_papers.authors: Xin Wang, Hao Yu, Zhengyang Zhuge et al.
top_papers.why: TRACE uses rollout-guided quantization for FP4 RL of MoE models, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy with practical efficiency gains.
top_papers.key_result: We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4 rollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.
evidence: We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4 rollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

evidence: nanoMuse is a minimal, complete personal agent under the GPL-3.0: an Android app, an iOS app (TestFlight), a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a web app, and the relay, nanoMuse Cloud, with its console. news.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
news.summary: Pollo AI, which serves more than 26 million users, launched Pollo Agent, a guided video-creation workflow built on OpenAI models including GPT-6 Astra and GPT-Image-2.5, with GPT-5.6 used for routing; 30% of creator sessions start from templates or trending-format workflows, and the company reports users spend more than 50% less time choosing or switching models. Its Marketing Studio Photo to Video Ads tool turns a still image and prompt into a short video, which one user used to produce a roughly 15-second fragrance ad.

news.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
news.summary: LegalOn Technologies integrated OpenAI's Codex into its development process and, by matching GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Astra to task complexity and applying department- and individual-level monthly usage limits, reports a 65% reduction in estimated daily costs and a 20% cost reduction in mature business areas while maintaining development speed. The company had initially given developers unlimited access to GPT-5.5 in Fast mode, then restricted Fast mode by default and used parallel task execution.

news.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
news.summary: OpenAI reported banning two covert influence operations, one from Russia and one from Iran, that combined its models with traditional techniques to support “false front” entities; the Iranian operation ran seven “journalist” personas pitching long-form articles, while the Russian operation co-opted unwitting people in Latin America to run a “think tank.” OpenAI assessed the Russia-origin operation as Category 5 on the IO Breakout Scale—its first Category 5 disruption since it began reporting—and the Iran-origin operation as Category 4, among 30 covert influence operations exposed in the last two and a half years.

news.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
news.summary: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, an Apache 2.0 licensed multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4 with 740 million parameters, mapping text, images, audio, and video into a unified embedding space. It uses as little as 270M parameters for text-only workloads with optional 170M vision and 300M audio encoders, supports up to an 8K token context, and improves MTEB Code from 68.76 to 78.68 (a 9.92-point gain), with on-device memory as low as ~191MB for text-only weights and ~567MB for the full multimodal model on a Google Pixel 11 Pro.

news.title: Does better work always mean better workers?
news.summary: A three-month randomized controlled trial with 133 patent attorneys at eleven IP law firms found that AI access raised patent-drafting scores by 0.34 standard deviations at 10 days (a 10-percentile-point gain) and 0.38 SD at 90 days (11 percentile points), with gains coming from fewer poor scores and more good scores rather than more excellent ones. Effects on learning differed by seniority: senior lawyers who used AI for 90 days showed stronger judgment, while junior lawyers showed no average skill gain, with scores splitting into more strong and more low scores.

news.title: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health
news.summary: Google Research presents the Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM), part of Google Earth AI, which compresses aggregated search trends, built-environment and mobility signals, and environmental determinants into location embeddings refreshed at a monthly cadence. The post reports five partner-driven case studies in which off-the-shelf PDFM location embeddings matched or improved on conventional inputs across disease domains, geographic settings, and epidemiological tasks without task-specific fine-tuning.

news.title: Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle
news.summary: Google Research published a workshop report, "Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle," drawing on a Google CAPS Workshop held in late 2025 in New York City that brought together more than 50 academic and industry leaders. The report frames agent privacy and security challenges at system, model, user, and ecosystem levels using the theory of Contextual Integrity, extended from information sharing to the appropriateness of agent actions.

news.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
news.summary: Google introduced Playground, an experimental browser-based platform where users create, play, and share custom games by describing them in text prompts, with no coding required. Games can be kept private, shared by link, or published to a community gallery with safety screenings, and it supports leaderboards and multiplayer in select genres; an integration with Unity Spark for more advanced mechanics and 3D capabilities is planned.

news.title: 2026 Usage Policy update
news.summary: Anthropic published a new Usage Policy taking effect November 12 that consolidates deceptive-activity rules scattered across elections, fraud, privacy, and disinformation sections into a new section titled 'Do Not Engage in Deceptive Campaigns or Artificial Activity,' and renames the elections section 'Do Not Undermine Democratic Processes.' The update also removes the blanket prohibition on personalized vote and campaign targeting, clarifies that weapons prohibitions cover guidance and control software and arming drones, and rewrites the surveillance and criminal justice section.

news.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
news.summary: Anthropic committed $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative, to make Claude available to more than 15 agencies including NASA, the National Institutes of Health, and the National Science Foundation. Over those three years it will provide Claude, Claude Code, and API credits to several hundred Genesis Mission research projects, partner with agencies and national laboratories on priorities including fusion energy and quantum computing, and provide training and technical support.

news.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
news.summary: Anthropic launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, starting with the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program, which brings frontier models, on-site engineers, and threat research to providers securing operational technology, and OSS Scanner, which offers open-source projects free regular security scans. Founding CIDP partners include Accenture, Booz Allen, CrowdStrike, Deloitte, Dragos, Hitachi, Insane Cyber, Nozomi Networks, Palo Alto Networks, PwC, and Rockwell Automation; Project Glasswing was merged earlier in the week into an expanded Cyber Verification Program.

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, described as its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, costing on average around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 and available for high-volume tasks such as summarization, classification, and database queries. It is the first Haiku-class model with an adjustable effort setting; Anthropic also halved the price of Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache reads (about 20% cheaper on most agentic work) and introduced a monthly API credit for Claude Max and Team subscribers.

news.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
news.summary: Microsoft Research Asia released Agent Lightning v1.0, a Harnessed Agentic RL framework of roughly 3,500 lines of code that trains agents using their real deployment harness via an LLM proxy, with native Kubernetes support and no dependency on paid commercial sandbox services. An end-to-end coding agent pipeline raised Qwen3.5-9B from 41.8% to 56.4% Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified (a 14.6 percentage point gain) using about 6,000 training samples.

news.title: What AI gets wrong and what failure teaches us
news.summary: A Microsoft Research Podcast episode features Jennifer Neville, a partner research manager at Microsoft Research, in conversation with Chad Atalla about evaluation's role in pushing AI performance and the surprising failures models show beyond traditional benchmarks. The episode notes Neville has published more than 130 papers with over 10,000 citations.

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described projects in which developers direct frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra through natural-language instructions to work with Omniverse libraries, including an Omniverse product manager building a warehouse humanoid simulator and a simulation technology manager building Zero to Alpamayo, a reusable environment based on San Francisco's Market Street, with a separate Cosmos3-Nano experiment varying weather and lighting. In another project, an RTX sensor validation engineer directed Astra and Claude Fable 5 agents to compare ovrtx camera and raw LiDAR outputs with recorded data, creating two digital twins from scratch and improving two existing ones over about three days.

news.title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
news.summary: Gears of War: E-Day, set 14 years before the original Gears of War and released globally Tuesday, Oct. 6, is now streaming on GeForce NOW, where Ultimate members can use GeForce RTX 5080-class cloud performance with DLSS and Reflex. Ten games join the GeForce NOW library this week, including seven new releases, and Fire TV users will soon be able to purchase memberships directly through Amazon.

news.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced RTX Spark for Windows laptops and compact desktops, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 cores and up to a 20-core Grace CPU connected at 600 GB/s, delivering up to one petaflop of FP4 AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory. Laptop preorders opened with availability October 16 and compact desktops in November; Microsoft also announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and the Surface Laptop Ultra was built around RTX Spark.

news.title: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA's State of AI in Telecommunications report states that 89% of respondents rate open source models and software as important to their company's AI strategy. NVIDIA announced the 30-billion-parameter Nemotron 3 Large Telco Model (LTM) fine-tuned by AdaptKey on open source telecom datasets, and released a full fine-tuning recipe using NVIDIA NeMo open libraries; SoftBank Corp. and AT&T are cited as operators building on open models.

news.title: 5 Steps to Create SimReady Assets for Robotics with Frontier AI Models
news.summary: NVIDIA outlined a five-step Omniverse and SimReady Foundation workflow for converting an ABB YuMi robot from STEP files into a simulation-ready OpenUSD asset, with frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra writing Python code that calls Omniverse tools. Physics configuration used manufacturer datasheets and a public URDF, with contact friction coefficients of 0.8 static and 0.6 dynamic, and both arms and grippers completed four pick-and-place cycles with colored cubes and a Sharpie marker modeled from a reference image.

news.title: Building Reliable Data Analytics Agents: Lessons from the KDD Cup
news.summary: NVIDIA's KGMON team placed second in the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents competition with a constrained harness around a small, fixed LLM, converting CSV and JSON files into tables in one SQLite database behind narrow schema() and sql() interfaces. The agent was limited to schema(), sql(query), write_answer(df), and prose_helper(), with a preflight schema-scouting step and execution traces used by a specialized inspector agent to categorize failures.

news.title: The Machines that Make the Machines
news.summary: NVIDIA's Seattle Robotics Lab and Isaac engineering team developed robotic systems to assemble GB300 tester trays, targeting busbar assembly and multi-connector insertion. A classical modular pipeline using FoundationPose, Lissajous-curve waypoint primitives, and an impedance controller achieved over 95% success on busbar assembly with a 160-second cycle time; connector grasping used a new pose-estimation framework called DOPER, and insertion policies were pretrained in Isaac Lab with sim-to-real RL then refined via SPARR residual training with force-torque inputs.

news.title: Validate AI Factory Changes with Digital Twins and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described using NVIDIA DSX Air, a node-based digital twin of AI factory infrastructure and software interfaces, together with NVIDIA Brev on-demand GPU compute, to validate configurations and software changes before hardware arrives. Agentic workflows interrogate the twin, run configuration checks, compare outcomes against policy, and produce evidence-backed recommendations within a governed loop, with the NVIDIA AI Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization demonstrating the pattern.

news.title: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
news.summary: Hugging Face reported using ML Intern to create a 0.8B version of the Qwen-Image 2.1 prompt rewriter after finding only compressed copies of the official 9B model that needs about 20 GB of memory; the 0.8B model runs on a CPU, returns valid output 99.7% of the time, and uses about a quarter of the teacher's tokens. The project cost USD 16, including labeling 8,797 example requests with the 9B model, and the author made five more models the same way.

news.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
news.summary: Hugging Face released two open decision models, d1-3B and d1-omni-600M (experimental), built on Liquid Foundation Models and answering in a single forward pass rather than generating tokens. d1-3B scores 48.57 on the Decision Index 0.2.1 and answers a question in 16 ms on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor, 26 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin, and 50 ms on an Orin Nano, with a mean score of 82.9 across seven datasets; d1-omni-600M scores 78.4 and supports text with images or audio.

news.title: Introducing Falcon ASR
news.summary: The Technology Innovation Institute introduced Falcon-ASR, a 1.6 billion parameter speech recognition model for Arabic with a focus on the Emirati dialect, also supporting English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese with the same weights. It achieved 20.92% average WER across six Arabic test sets versus the best published 23.17% in the leaderboard snapshot, 22.73% WER and 10.19% CER on an internal Emirati evaluation, and 5.74% mean WER on seven public English test sets.

news.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
news.summary: Hugging Face reported that fine-tuned Nemotron models reached gold-medal level at both IMO 2026 and IOI 2026: Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC with SFT and GenCorrect scored 535.4/600 at IOI, above the 361.12 gold threshold and the top human score of 498.27, and a Nemotron 3 Ultra generate-verify-refine system scored 30/42 at IMO, above the official gold threshold of 29. Training used 22,000 curated competitive-programming problems and an SFT corpus of 414,890 examples across 15,818 unique proof problems, with RL on 9,597 proof problems.

news.title: Normalizing Trajectory Models
news.summary: Apple researchers introduced Normalizing Trajectory Models (NTM), which model each reverse step as a conditional normalizing flow with exact likelihood training and combine shallow invertible blocks with a deep parallel predictor across the trajectory. NTM's exact trajectory likelihood enables self-distillation to produce high-quality samples in four steps, matching or outperforming strong image generation baselines on text-to-image benchmarks in four sampling steps.

news.title: RISED: Rubrics for Agentic Multi-Environment Selection and Self-Distillation
news.summary: Apple researchers presented RISED, which repurposes rubrics for online data selection and policy supervision in multi-environment agent RL: an LLM judge tags each rollout with a shared rubric vocabulary, positive rubrics supply privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, and negative rubrics steer subsequent rollout generation away from failure modes. Across model backbones RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment.

news.title: Negotiating Ontological Boundaries in User-Authored Personal Sensing Systems
news.summary: Apple-affiliated researchers (with Stanford University) report a week-long exploratory study in which participants used one of two open-ended Wizard of Oz probes to train a personalized machine learning system on phenomena they defined themselves. The study identifies four sites where ontological boundaries were negotiated: the boundaries of a phenomenon, the subject as part of relations, what is signal and what is noise, and the objectivity of data.

news.title: Pay-per-inference for AI agents: How BlockRun and Incarna use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
news.summary: Incarna used Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments to let its agents pay BlockRun per inference request, cutting work to add x402 payment support from months to days and putting an end-to-end pay-per-inference flow into production. BlockRun is a pay-as-you-go inference router serving more than 90 models from more than 15 providers over x402, and AgentCore payments settles in USDC on the Base network with spending limits enforced at the infrastructure layer.

news.title: Share GPU clusters across teams with isolation and fairness using Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
news.summary: AWS published a reference architecture for multi-tenant sharing of a single Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS cluster, using AWS IAM Identity Center for centralized authentication, per-team SageMaker AI domains, Kubernetes namespaces for workload isolation, HyperPod Task Governance for resource allocation, and namespace-level cost allocation for chargeback. The example shows two teams (Team A and Team B) operating in separate namespaces with per-team permission sets and IAM roles.

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
news.summary: AWS announced availability of Claude Haiku 5.5 on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS, describing it as the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work, at around 75 percent less cost than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks. It is the first Haiku model with effort controls, and AWS positions it as pairing with Claude Opus 5.5, which handles planning and judgment calls.

news.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS described adding real-time access control list enforcement for RAG on Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, checking permissions directly with the authoritative source at query time rather than relying on replicated ACL attributes. The post identifies three weaknesses of the replicate-and-filter approach: the AI system is not the source of truth, stale permissions from pull-based syncs create security gaps, and evolving data source permission models can break ACL mapping.

en.editorial: This week's 4,453 submissions reflect steady output across core areas, with one clear mover: mechanistic interpretability and steering rose 1.8-fold to 10.11 papers per thousand, signaling renewed focus on understanding model internals. Among the most upvoted work, 'Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability' (167 upvotes) leads, followed by 'Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation' (158). Readers working on RL efficiency should not miss 'LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches' (120), which cuts training memory by up to 45.7%, and 'Recursive Self-Rewrite' (103) shows pass@3 gains from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2. For embodied AI, 'World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning' (96) achieves 85.8% on LIBERO-Plus, and 'Long-WAM' (90) highlights the value of autoregressive video pretraining. Also notable: TRACE (88) enables FP4 RL with up to 5.4× rollout speedup.

top_papers.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
top_papers.authors: Team Kandinsky, Julia Agafonova, Bulat Akhmatov et al.
top_papers.why: 呈现了一个大规模同步音视频基础模型，具有出色的人工评估结果，对多模态生成研究人员很有用。
top_papers.key_result: 本文提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，一个用于同步文本到音视频生成的基础扩散模型系列，包括 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数），可生成 5 秒视频片段，带有同步的 44 kHz 音频和最高全高清（1920×1080）分辨率。在并排人工评估中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于其前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先的音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其在语音质量方面。
evidence: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).

Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920×1080).

In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.

top_papers.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
top_papers.authors: Shaokun Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Jian Hu et al.
top_papers.why: 提出一种内存高效的 RL 后训练方法，最多将内存降低 45.7%，并能在单个 8-GPU 节点上训练 27B 参数模型，解决了重大实际瓶颈。
top_papers.key_result: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance, and it enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node where dense Adam runs out of memory.
evidence: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical.
Over the complete runs, average memory decreases from 9.18 to 7.18 GiB at 1.5B and from 31.82 to 17.29 GiB at 7B, reductions of 21.8% and 45.7%, respectively.

top_papers.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
top_papers.authors: Zongxia Li, Yucheng Shi, Zhongzhi Li et al.
top_papers.why: 它展示了一种可扩展的自蒸馏流程，将特定 harness 的成功转化为通用训练轨迹，在终端任务基准上带来大幅提升。
top_papers.key_result: 在 RSR 的重写轨迹上训练优于基座模型和直接轨迹 SFT：与基座模型相比，Terminal-Bench 2 上 pass@3 从 57.0% 提高到 74.2%，Terminal-Bench 4 上从 1.5% 提高到 9.1%，自建 Terminal-Bench Hard 上从 39.0% 提高到 63.0%，Software Terminal-Bench 上从 3.0% 提高到 6.0%，而 Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench 的过程奖励从 0.21 升至 0.29。随后进行多 harness 发现，3 个 harness 联合解决 759 个任务，比记录池中最强单个 harness 多 34.3%。
evidence: Across approximately 3K self-curated terminal tasks, three harnesses jointly solve 759 tasks, 34.3% more than the strongest individual harness in the recorded pool.

RSR expands 2,001 successful source trajectories into 11,094 rewritten trajectories for supervised finetuning. Training on these trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT.

Compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on our self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on our Software Terminal-Bench. Process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29.

top_papers.title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
top_papers.authors: Fei Zhang, Zhaochong An, Duncan Frost et al.
top_papers.why: 它通过预测稀疏视觉子目标来解决长时程世界-动作建模，提升了效率和分布外鲁棒性。
top_papers.key_result: ProWAM 在 LIBERO-Plus（85.8%）和随机化 RoboTwin（75.7%）上取得新的 state-of-the-art 结果，超越最强基线，相对提升最高达 +35.9%；它还在 RoboCasa365 上达到 48.1% 成功率，在 Composite-Unseen 划分上达到 18.2%，并在零样本真实世界实验中达到 70.0% 成功率，比最强基线高 +15.0（从 55.0% 提高到 70.0%，相对提升 +27.3%）。
evidence: On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%.
On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall.
Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes.

top_papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
top_papers.authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu et al.
top_papers.why: 强有力的结果表明，自回归预训练解锁了长上下文世界-动作模型，推动了实时机器人控制的发展。
top_papers.key_result: 我们的核心发现是，访问历史并不等同于利用历史：当视频基础模型以自回归方式（AR）预训练时，更长的历史带来的益处要大得多。在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，将上下文从 0.0 秒增加到 19.2 秒，成功率从 63.3% 提高到 78.7%，而双向预训练的初始化没有净收益；机器人领域的 AR 预训练进一步提高了 GR-1 和 LIBERO-Long 上的峰值成功率；Long-WAM 还在 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0 和 DOMINO 上取得了对比方法中的最佳结果，现实世界部署包括动态杯子堆叠任务上 95% 的成功率。
evidence: Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long.
Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO.
Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where _0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials.

top_papers.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
top_papers.authors: Xin Wang, Hao Yu, Zhengyang Zhuge et al.
top_papers.why: TRACE 对 MoE 模型的 FP4 RL 使用 rollout 引导的量化，在获得实际效率提升的同时直接减少了训练与 rollout 之间的差异。
top_papers.key_result: 我们在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型上评估了 TRACE，覆盖推理、编码和长程 RL 任务。我们的结果表明，TRACE 能够实现联合 FP4 权重/激活和 FP4 KV-cache rollout，其 RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当，同时相比对 BF16 训练策略进行事后 FP4 量化，实现了高达 5.4 的 rollout 加速和强大的最终 FP4 性能。
evidence: We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4 rollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

top_papers.title: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
top_papers.authors: Zhaochong An, Fei Zhang, Menglin Jia et al.

top_papers.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
top_papers.authors: Guangyi Liu, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
top_papers.why: 带有跨设备持久记忆的开源个人智能体是一次重要发布，也是当天获得最多赞同的论文。
top_papers.key_result: The paper presents nanoMuse, a minimal, complete open-source personal agent under the GPL-3.0 (Android, iOS, desktop, web apps plus the relay), first released on September 25, 2026, described as of version 0.1.40 (October 2026).
evidence: nanoMuse is a minimal, complete personal agent under the GPL-3.0: an Android app, an iOS app (TestFlight), a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a web app, and the relay, nanoMuse Cloud, with its console. The first release was on September 25, 2026; this report describes the code as of version 0.1.40 (October 2026).

Against Muse , nanoMuse adds hands on the Android phone's screen; the phone and the computer are operated on the device itself, not in a VM; every part is open, the relay included; and the model is the person's choice.

top_papers.authors: Jiajun Chen, Haoyu Wu, Mingda Jia et al.

news.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
news.summary: Pollo AI 服务超过 26 million 用户，推出了 Pollo Agent，这是一个基于 OpenAI 模型（包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5）构建的引导式视频创建工作流，使用 GPT-5.6 进行路由；30% 的创作者会话从模板或热门格式工作流开始，公司报告称用户在选择或切换模型上花费的时间减少超过 50%。其 Marketing Studio 的“Photo to Video Ads”工具将静态图像和提示转化为短视频，一位用户用它制作了大约 15 秒的香水广告。

news.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
news.summary: LegalOn Technologies 将 OpenAI 的 Codex 集成到其开发流程中，通过将 GPT-6 Luna、GPT-6.1 Sol 和 GPT-6 Astra 与任务复杂度匹配，并应用部门和个人的月度用量限制，报告称每日估算成本降低 65%，成熟业务领域成本降低 20%，同时保持开发速度。该公司最初让开发人员无限使用 GPT-5.5 的 Fast 模式，随后默认限制 Fast 模式并使用并行任务执行。

news.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
news.summary: OpenAI 报告称已封禁两个隐蔽影响行动，一个来自俄罗斯，一个来自伊朗，它们将其模型与传统技术结合，为“虚假前台”实体提供支持；伊朗行动运营了七个“记者”人格，推销长篇报道，而俄罗斯行动则利用不知情的拉丁美洲人员运营一个“智库”。OpenAI 将源自俄罗斯的行动评估为 IO Breakout Scale 上的 Category 5，这是其开始报告以来首次 Category 5 级别的破坏；将源自伊朗的行动评估为 Category 4。在过去两年半中，已揭露 30 个隐蔽影响行动。

news.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
news.summary: Google DeepMind 推出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，这是一个基于 Gemma 4 的 Apache 2.0 许可多模态嵌入模型，拥有 740 million 参数，将文本、图像、音频和视频映射到统一的嵌入空间。对于纯文本工作负载，它仅需 270M 参数，可选 170M 视觉编码器和 300M 音频编码器，支持高达 8K token 上下文，并将 MTEB Code 从 68.76 提高到 78.68（提升 9.92 分）；在 Google Pixel 11 Pro 上，纯文本权重的设备内存低至约 191MB，完整多模态模型约 567MB。

news.title: Does better work always mean better workers?
news.summary: 一项为期三个月、涉及 11 家知识产权律师事务所 133 名专利律师的随机对照试验发现，使用 AI 使专利撰写得分在 10 天时提高了 0.34 个标准差（提升 10 个百分位点），在 90 天时提高了 0.38 SD（提升 11 个百分位点），增益来自更少的差评分和更多的好评分，而不是更多的优秀评分。对学习的影响因资历而异：使用 AI 90 天的资深律师表现出更强的判断力，而初级律师平均技能没有提高，得分分化为更多的高分和更多的低分。

news.title: Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health
news.summary: Google Research 发布了 Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM)，它是 Google Earth AI 的一部分，将聚合搜索趋势、建成环境和流动性信号以及环境决定因素压缩为每月更新的位置嵌入。文章报告了五个由合作伙伴推动的案例研究，在这些研究中，现成的 PDFM 位置嵌入在疾病领域、地理环境和流行病学任务中与常规输入相当或有所改进，无需针对特定任务微调。

news.title: Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle
news.summary: Google Research 发布了一份研讨会报告《Open and Emergent Problems in Agentic Privacy and Security: A Contextual Angle》，基于 2025 年底在纽约市举行的 Google CAPS Workshop，该研讨会汇集了 50 多位学术界和产业界领袖。报告运用 Contextual Integrity 理论，从系统、模型、用户和生态系统层面阐述智能体隐私与安全挑战，并将其从信息共享扩展到智能体行为的适当性。

news.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
news.summary: Google 推出了 Playground，这是一个基于浏览器的实验性平台，用户通过文本提示描述即可创建、游玩和分享自定义游戏，无需编写代码。游戏可以保持私密、通过链接分享，或经过安全审核后发布到社区画廊；它支持排行榜和特定类型的多人游戏，并计划与 Unity Spark 集成以支持更高级的机制和 3D 能力。

news.title: 2026 Usage Policy update
news.summary: Anthropic 发布了新的使用政策，将于 November 12 生效，将散落在选举、欺诈、隐私和虚假信息章节中的欺骗性活动规则整合到新章节“Do Not Engage in Deceptive Campaigns or Artificial Activity”中，并将选举章节更名为“Do Not Undermine Democratic Processes”。该更新还取消了对个性化投票和竞选定位的全面禁止，澄清武器禁令涵盖制导与控制软件以及武装无人机，并重写了监控与刑事司法章节。

news.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
news.summary: Anthropic 承诺在三年内向联邦计划 Genesis Mission 投入 $150 million，使 Claude 可供包括 NASA、美国国立卫生研究院和美国国家科学基金会在内的超过 15 个机构使用。在这三年中，它将向数百个 Genesis Mission 研究项目提供 Claude、Claude Code 和 API 额度，与各机构和国家实验室在聚变能源和量子计算等优先事项上合作，并提供培训和技术支持。

news.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
news.summary: Anthropic 启动了 Anthropic Cyber Mission，首先推出关键基础设施防御计划（CIDP），该计划为保护运营技术的提供商提供前沿模型、现场工程师和威胁研究；同时推出 OSS Scanner，为开源项目提供免费定期安全扫描。CIDP 创始合作伙伴包括 Accenture、Booz Allen、CrowdStrike、Deloitte、Dragos、Hitachi、Insane Cyber、Nozomi Networks、Palo Alto Networks、PwC 和 Rockwell Automation；Project Glasswing 已于本周早些时候并入扩展后的网络验证计划。

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
news.summary: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Haiku 5.5，称其是最便宜、最快、能力最强的小型模型，运行成本平均比 Haiku 4.5 低约 75%，适用于摘要、分类和数据库查询等大批量任务。它是首个具有可调 effort 设置的 Haiku 级模型；Anthropic 还将 Claude Sonnet 5.5 缓存读取的价格下调一半（在大多数智能体工作上便宜约 20%），并为 Claude Max 和 Team 订阅者提供每月 API 额度。

news.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
news.summary: 微软亚洲研究院发布了 Agent Lightning v1.0，这是一个约 3,500 行代码的 Harnessed Agentic RL 框架，通过 LLM 代理使用真实部署 harness 训练智能体，原生支持 Kubernetes，且不依赖付费商业沙盒服务。端到端编码智能体流程使用约 6,000 个训练样本，将 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 Pass@1 从 41.8% 提高到 56.4%（提升 14.6 个百分点）。

news.title: What AI gets wrong and what failure teaches us
news.summary: 微软研究院播客的一期节目邀请微软研究院合作研究经理 Jennifer Neville 与 Chad Atalla 对话，讨论评估在推动 AI 性能中的作用，以及模型在传统基准之外表现出的令人意外的失败。节目中提到 Neville 已发表超过 130 篇论文，引用超过 10,000 次。

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了多个项目，开发人员通过自然语言指令指导 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型与 Omniverse 库配合工作，其中一位 Omniverse 产品经理构建了仓库人形机器人仿真器，一位仿真技术经理构建了 Zero to Alpamayo——一个基于旧金山 Market Street 的可复用环境，并有一个独立的 Cosmos3-Nano 实验用于变化天气和照明。另一个项目中，一位 RTX 传感器验证工程师指导 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5 智能体将 ovrtx 相机和原始 LiDAR 输出与记录数据进行比较，在大约三天内从零创建了两个数字孪生，并改进了两个现有模型。

news.title: Rally Up: ‘Gears of War: E-Day’ Launches on GeForce NOW
news.summary: Gears of War: E-Day, set 14 years before the original Gears of War and released globally Tuesday, Oct. 6, is now streaming on GeForce NOW, where Ultimate members can use GeForce RTX 5080-class cloud performance with DLSS and Reflex. Ten games join the GeForce NOW library this week, including seven new releases, and Fire TV users will soon be able to purchase memberships directly through Amazon.

news.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced RTX Spark for Windows laptops and compact desktops, combining a Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 cores and up to a 20-core Grace CPU connected at 600 GB/s, delivering up to one petaflop of FP4 AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory. Laptop preorders opened with availability October 16 and compact desktops in November; Microsoft also announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC), and the Surface Laptop Ultra was built around RTX Spark.

news.title: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 的《电信行业 AI 现状》报告指出，89% 的受访者认为开源模型和软件对其公司的 AI 战略很重要。NVIDIA 发布了由 AdaptKey 在开源电信数据集上微调的 30-billion-parameter Nemotron 3 Large Telco Model (LTM)，并公布了使用 NVIDIA NeMo 开源库的完整微调配方；SoftBank Corp. 和 AT&T 被列为基于开放模型进行构建的运营商。

news.title: 5 Steps to Create SimReady Assets for Robotics with Frontier AI Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 概述了一个五步 Omniverse 和 SimReady Foundation 工作流，用于将 ABB YuMi 机器人从 STEP 文件转换为仿真就绪的 OpenUSD 资产，GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型编写调用 Omniverse 工具的 Python 代码。物理配置使用制造商数据表和公开 URDF，接触摩擦系数为静摩擦 0.8、动摩擦 0.6；双臂和夹具完成了四个取放循环，使用彩色方块和根据参考图像建模的 Sharpie 马克笔。

news.title: Building Reliable Data Analytics Agents: Lessons from the KDD Cup
news.summary: NVIDIA 的 KGMON 团队在 KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents 竞赛中获得第二名，他们围绕一个小型固定 LLM 构建了受限 harness，将 CSV 和 JSON 文件转换为一个 SQLite 数据库中的表，并仅暴露有限的 schema() 和 sql() 接口。该智能体仅限于 schema()、sql(query)、write_answer(df) 和 prose_helper()，并通过预检 schema 侦察步骤和执行轨迹，由专门的 inspector 智能体对失败进行分类。

news.title: The Machines that Make the Machines
news.summary: NVIDIA 西雅图机器人实验室和 Isaac 工程团队开发了用于组装 GB300 测试托盘的机器人系统，目标包括母线组装和多连接器插入。使用 FoundationPose、Lissajous 曲线路径点基元和阻抗控制器的经典模块化流水线在母线组装上实现了超过 95% 的成功率，循环时间为 160 秒；连接器抓取使用了一种名为 DOPER 的新位姿估计框架，插入策略在 Isaac Lab 中通过 sim-to-real RL 预训练，然后通过 SPARR 残差训练结合力矩输入进行精细调整。

news.title: Validate AI Factory Changes with Digital Twins and AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了使用 NVIDIA DSX Air（AI 工厂基础设施和软件接口的基于节点的数字孪生）与 NVIDIA Brev 按需 GPU 计算相结合，在硬件到位之前验证配置和软件变更。智能体工作流查询该数字孪生、运行配置检查、将结果与策略进行比较，并在受治理的循环内生成有据可依的建议；NVIDIA AI Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization 展示了这一模式。

news.title: The model that didn't exist, so you made it yourself
news.summary: Hugging Face 报告称，在发现官方 Qwen-Image 2.1 prompt rewriter 的 9B 模型只有压缩副本且需要约 20 GB 内存后，使用 ML Intern 创建了 0.8B 版本；该 0.8B 模型可在 CPU 上运行，99.7% 的时间返回有效输出，并且使用的 token 约为教师模型的四分之一。项目成本为 USD 16，包括使用 9B 模型标注 8,797 条示例请求；作者还用相同方法制作了另外五个模型。

news.title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
news.summary: Hugging Face 发布了两个开放决策模型 d1-3B 和 d1-omni-600M（实验性），它们构建于 Liquid Foundation Models 之上，通过单次前向传播返回答案，而不是生成 token。d1-3B 在 Decision Index 0.2.1 上得分为 48.57，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor 上回答问题耗时 16 ms，在 Jetson AGX Orin 上为 26 ms，在 Orin Nano 上为 50 ms，在七个数据集上的平均得分为 82.9；d1-omni-600M 得分为 78.4，支持文本与图像或音频。

news.title: Introducing Falcon ASR
news.summary: 技术创新研究所推出了 Falcon-ASR，这是一个用于阿拉伯语的 1.6 billion 参数语音识别模型，重点关注阿联酋方言，同时使用相同权重支持英语、法语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语。它在六个阿拉伯语测试集上取得 20.92% 的平均 WER，而排行榜快照中最佳结果为 23.17%；在内部阿联酋语评估中 WER 为 22.73%，CER 为 10.19%；在七个公开英语测试集上平均 WER 为 5.74%。

news.title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
news.summary: Hugging Face 报告称，经过微调的 Nemotron 模型在 IMO 2026 和 IOI 2026 上均达到金牌水平：Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC 结合 SFT 和 GenCorrect 在 IOI 上获得 535.4/600 分，高于 361.12 的金牌线以及人类最高分 498.27；一个 Nemotron 3 Ultra 的 generate-verify-refine 系统在 IMO 上获得 30/42 分，高于 29 分的官方金牌线。训练使用了 22,000 个精选竞赛编程题目，以及包含 414,890 个样本、涵盖 15,818 个不同证明问题的 SFT 语料，并在 9,597 个证明问题上进行 RL。

news.title: Normalizing Trajectory Models
news.summary: 苹果的研究人员提出了 Normalizing Trajectory Models (NTM)，将每个逆向步骤建模为具有精确似然训练的条件归一化流，并结合浅层可逆块与跨轨迹的深层并行预测器。NTM 的精确轨迹似然支持自蒸馏，在四步内生成高质量样本，在四个采样步骤中于文本到图像基准上达到或超越强图像生成基线。

news.title: RISED: Rubrics for Agentic Multi-Environment Selection and Self-Distillation
news.summary: 苹果的研究人员提出了 RISED，该方法在多环境智能体 RL 中重新利用评标标准进行在线数据选择和策略监督：LLM 评判器使用共享评标词汇为每个 rollout 打标签，正面评标为在策略自蒸馏教师提供特权上下文，负面评标引导后续 rollout 生成远离失败模式。在各种模型骨干上，RISED 在所有环境中取得最高平均通过率，并在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二。

news.title: Negotiating Ontological Boundaries in User-Authored Personal Sensing Systems
news.summary: 苹果关联研究人员（与斯坦福大学合作）报告了一项为期一周的探索性研究，参与者使用两个开放式 Wizard of Oz 探针之一，就他们自己定义的现象训练个性化机器学习系统。研究确定了四个本体论边界被协商的场所：现象的边界、作为关系一部分的主体、什么是信号什么是噪声，以及数据的客观性。

news.title: Pay-per-inference for AI agents: How BlockRun and Incarna use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
news.summary: Incarna 使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments，让其智能体按每次推理请求向 BlockRun 付费，将添加 x402 支付支持的工作从数月缩短到数天，并上线端到端按推理付费流程。BlockRun 是按使用量付费的推理路由器，通过 x402 服务于来自超过 15 家提供商的超过 90 个模型；AgentCore payments 在 Base 网络上以 USDC 结算，并在基础设施层强制执行支出限制。

news.title: Share GPU clusters across teams with isolation and fairness using Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
news.summary: AWS 发布了一个参考架构，用于多租户共享单个 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod EKS 集群，使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 进行集中认证，为每个团队设置 SageMaker AI 域，使用 Kubernetes 命名空间实现工作负载隔离，通过 HyperPod Task Governance 进行资源分配，并在命名空间级别进行成本分摊用于计费。示例展示了两个团队（Team A 和 Team B）在独立的命名空间中运行，拥有各自的权限集和 IAM 角色。

news.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
news.summary: AWS 宣布 Claude Haiku 5.5 在 Amazon Bedrock 和 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 可用，称其为 Claude 5.5 系列中最快、最高效的模型，适用于子智能体和高吞吐、成本敏感的工作，在大多数任务上成本比 Claude Haiku 4.5 低约 75%。它是首个具有 effort 控制功能的 Haiku 模型，AWS 将其定位为与 Claude Opus 5.5 搭配，后者处理规划和判断类任务。

news.title: Rethinking access control for RAG with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS 介绍了为 Amazon Quick 和 Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases 上的 RAG 添加实时访问控制列表（ACL）执行，在查询时直接与权威源核对权限，而不是依赖复制过来的 ACL 属性。文章指出了复制再过滤方法的三个弱点：AI 系统不是事实来源、基于拉取的同步导致权限陈旧从而产生安全漏洞，以及数据源权限模型的演进可能破坏 ACL 映射。

zh.editorial: 本周的 4,453 篇投稿反映出各核心领域的稳定产出，其中一个明显动向：机制可解释性与 steering 上升 1.8 倍，达到每千篇 10.11 篇，表明对理解模型内部机制重新关注。在最受好评的工作中，“Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability”（167 个赞同）领先，其次是“Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation”（158 个赞同）。从事 RL 效率研究的读者不应错过“LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches”（120 个赞同），该方法将训练内存最多降低 45.7%；还有“Recursive Self-Rewrite”（103 个赞同）显示 Terminal-Bench 2 上 pass@3 从 57.0% 提升到 74.2%。在具身 AI 方面，“World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning”（96 个赞同）在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 85.8%，而“Long-WAM”（90 个赞同）凸显了自回归视频预训练的价值。同样值得注意：TRACE（88 个赞同）支持 FP4 RL，加速 rollout 最高可达 5.4×。
